summary: v56j + v56k/l QA — both PASS. GATE BACKEND: curl POST /api/v1/escrow/transactions/{TMP-UIH}/sign with intended_action release_to_contractor → HTTP 409 'Release to contractor is blocked — bid TMP-UIH is accounting_cleared, not awarded yet. EMD can only be released … (pending: committee award / admin sign-off).' Same endpoint with release_to_vendor → HTTP 200, PMC side signed. bid_status surfaces in GET /api/v1/staff/escrow/signatures per row. GATE UI (logged in via browser as escrow@pmcmanagers.com / Escrow@123, active_role=escrow_agent → /staff): staff-escrow-release-panel-TMP-UIH renders. Action dropdown (staff-escrow-action-TMP-UIH) options: 'Release → Contractor (winning vendor) — locked until awarded' with disabled attr set, 'Refund → Vendor (bid did not win)' enabled, 'Forfeit (withdrawal / mis-declaration)' enabled. Selecting release_to_contractor → Sign button (staff-escrow-release-sign-TMP-UIH) disabled, label flips to 'Locked until awarded', title tooltip 'Release to contractor is locked until the bid is awarded (certifier → legal → accounting → committee).' Warning hint reads '⚠ Release to contractor unlocks only once this bid is awarded (certifier → legal → accounting → committee). Current bid status: accounting_cleared.' Switching to release_to_vendor or forfeit re-enables the Sign button. COMPLETED (v56j) — logged in as certifier@pmcmanagers.com / Escrow@123, active_role=site_certifier. staff-nav-completed present in sidebar; clicking renders staff-completed panel with staff-completed-filters containing completed-filter-from, completed-filter-to, completed-filter-action, completed-filter-clear, and completed-export-csv (all testids present and interactive). Processed-bids list is empty for this account (0 items) — per request this is acceptable; empty-state 'No processed items match. Items you Accept/Reject appear here with their audit trail.' is displayed. Clear button works; Export CSV triggers a download named pmc-my-decisions.csv without error. Readability across both portals is strong (cream paper rgb(246,243,236) on dark ink, emerald chrome header, brass accents).

issues: From/To filters use the browser-native date picker (<input type='date'>) rather than a shadcn/calendar component. Minor consistency note, not a blocker.

critical_code_review_comments: Gate is enforced at BOTH layers (backend _assert_release_governance returns 409 with pending-stage message; frontend EscrowRow greys the option, disables Sign, adds tooltip + hint) — correct defence-in-depth.
bid_status is now included on each row of /staff/escrow/signatures, enabling the hint ('Current bid status: accounting_cleared.') without an extra round-trip. Good shape.
CompletedPanel renders filter controls + empty-state cleanly even when the processed list is empty — safer than hiding the toolbar.

Action dropdown in Completed is dynamically derived from processed items (only 'All actions' visible when list is empty). Consider seeding static options (accept/reject) so filters are visible even for empty history — minor UX nit.
seed_data_creation: None.
